MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into between Acme Industries Inc. and
Northwind Supply Co.

1.1 Definitions. In this Agreement, "Deliverables" means the software, documentation
and materials to be produced by the Supplier as described in each Statement of Work.
"Confidential Information" has the meaning given in Section 6.1.

1.2 Order of Precedence. In the event of a conflict between this Agreement and any
Statement of Work, this Agreement shall prevail except where the Statement of Work
expressly states otherwise and is signed by both parties.

2.1 Provision of Services. The Supplier shall perform the Services with reasonable
skill and care in accordance with each Statement of Work agreed under Section 1.2.

2.2 Acceptance. The Customer shall have thirty (30) days from delivery to test the
Deliverables against the acceptance criteria. Deliverables not rejected in writing
within that period shall be deemed accepted.

3.1 Fees. The Customer shall pay the fees set out in the applicable Statement of Work.
All invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

3.2 Late Payment. Interest shall accrue on any overdue payment under Section 3.1 at
the rate of one and a half percent (1.5%) per month. Suspension of Services for
non-payment shall not constitute a breach by the Supplier.

4.1 Warranty. The Supplier represents and warrants that the Deliverables will conform
in all material respects to the specifications for a period of twelve (12) months
following acceptance under Section 2.2.

4.2 Exclusive Remedy. The Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of the
warranty in Section 4.1 shall be repair or replacement of the non-conforming
Deliverables, or refund of the fees paid for them.

5.1 Limitation of Liability. In no event shall either party be liable for any indirect,
incidental or consequential damages. The aggregate liability of either party arising
out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months
preceding the claim.

5.2 Exclusions. The limitation of liability in Section 5.1 shall not apply to breaches
of confidentiality, infringement of intellectual property rights, or the indemnity
obligations set out in Section 7.1.

6.1 Confidential Information. Each party shall keep confidential all non-public
information disclosed by the other party and shall not disclose it to any third party
without prior written consent.

6.2 Duration of Confidentiality. The obligations in Section 6.1 shall continue for
five (5) years following termination of this Agreement, and indefinitely in respect
of trade secrets.

7.1 Indemnification. The Supplier shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the
Customer against any and all claims, losses, damages and expenses arising out of any
allegation that the Deliverables infringe the intellectual property rights of a
third party.

7.2 Indemnity Procedure. The Customer shall promptly notify the Supplier of any claim
for which indemnity is sought under Section 7.1 and shall grant the Supplier sole
control of the defence and settlement of that claim.

8.1 Intellectual Property. All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall
vest in the Customer upon payment in full of the applicable fees under Section 3.1.
The Supplier retains all rights in its pre-existing materials.

8.2 Exclusive License. The Supplier grants the Customer a sole and exclusive license
to use the Supplier's pre-existing materials to the extent necessary to exploit the
Deliverables described in Section 8.1.

9.1 Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement upon sixty
(60) days prior written notice to the other party.

9.2 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon
written notice if the other party commits a material breach that remains uncured for
thirty (30) days.

9.3 Survival. The provisions of Section 5.1, Section 6.1, Section 7.1 and Section 8.1
shall survive termination or expiry of this Agreement.

10.1 Assignment. Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement without the prior
written consent of the other party, except to a successor in connection with a merger
or sale of substantially all of its assets.

10.2 Force Majeure. Neither party shall be liable for any failure to perform caused by
an event beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, or natural disaster.

10.3 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of
Delaware, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of its courts.
